R6F-bear-backcountry-0004.name: 5.3 km NW of Tetachuck Lake
R6F-bear-backcountry-0004.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).
R6F-bear-backcountry-0004.parkWhat: pull off on an unnamed gravel road

evidence.t: Cutblock harvested 2014 (12 years old), 440 m NE: cutblocks and logging road edges green up first in spring (65%) and grow berries for the fall feed (lesson: Black bear).
Burn from 2018 (fire R12068), right here: burned areas are spring bear food (90%) and huckleberry grows in old burns (80%) (lessons: Black bear Masterclass 5, Habitat tour).
Unnamed wetland 100 m SE: stream sides and skunk cabbage swamps are spring food, and bears forage on berries and spawning fish in fall (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
1 km or more from pavement and 2 km from a town: bears near people feed more at night (75%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 6).

plan: Drive: from Village of Burns Lake, about 121 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 53.38818, -125.9433, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 5.0 km SW, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 5 m, about 101 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 100 m N of the spot at 1,124 m (53.35247, -125.9872). Water: unnamed wetland 160 m SE (estimate).

Hunt: black bear, Apr, May, June, Aug, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass berry slopes, cutblocks and road edges at dawn and the last 2 hours of light, wind in your face (Tip). A bear under 2 years old and any bear with it are closed (99%, synopsis page 11).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 180 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-2, Region 6. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-02, closures 2026-10-16.
R6F-bear-backcountry-0004.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 6-2: about 123 hunter days a year for black bear (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.03 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
